definitions.gloss: mechanism; structure; system; how something works
definitions.explanation: The way parts are arranged or connected to create a functioning whole.

examples.japanese: この{機械|きかい}の{仕組|しく}みを{説明|せつめい}してください。
examples.english: Please explain how this machine works.

examples.japanese: {社会|しゃかい}{保障|ほしょう}の{仕組|しく}みは{複雑|ふくざつ}だ。
examples.english: The social security system is complicated.

examples.japanese: {成功|せいこう}するための{仕組|しく}みを{作|つく}る。
examples.english: To create a system for success.

notes:
FORMATION:
{仕|し} (doing) + {組|く}む (to assemble)

From the idea of how things are put together.

COLLOCATIONS:
・{仕組|しく}みを{理解|りかい}する - to understand the mechanism
・{仕組|しく}みを{作|つく}る - to create a system
・{仕組|しく}みを{変|か}える - to change the system
・〜という{仕組|しく}み - a system where ~
・{仕組|しく}みがわかる - to understand how it works

SIMILAR WORDS:
・システム - system (loanword)
・{構造|こうぞう} - structure
・{仕掛|しか}け - mechanism, device, trick
・メカニズム - mechanism (loanword, more technical)

NUANCE:
{仕組|しく}み is commonly used when explaining how things work in everyday language.
